name: Kisagi Mimi
source:
"Shut up. Mi hates noisy people."

One of two twin 'sisters' from the Kizaki clan, whose duties are to oversee the Hanamukenogi ceremony. A girl who 'hates' everything in the world, who can always be seen with a scowl on her face. She and her older sister, [url=https://vndb.org/c166558]Ruru[/url], were born as two halves of a whole, with Mimi being in possession of all that has to do with 'hatred'.

Flower: Christmas Rose
Bloom Factor: [???]
Magic: [Chishinka] — Manipulate Gravity

[Translated by the [url=https://Acacia.wiki.gg/Mimi_Kizaki]Acacia Wiki[/url].]
[Description taken from the [url=https://https://mahoumura.com/]Official Site[/url].]
